candidate_records.source_text: I wanted to cancel the hospital scan next week, but I also knew the scan wasn't the thing I was really afraid of.
candidate_records.notes: The author expresses a desire to cancel a planned hospital scan and acknowledges their true fear is not of the scan itself.
